B.Tech · CSE (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning)

Train, test and deploy AI models.

Work with data, train models and test their predictions. Turn those models into recommendation, vision and language applications.

Book a campus visit

What makes a model reliable

A model learns patterns from the data you give it. You need statistics, sound data and a way to test predictions on examples the model has never seen. That is how you find where a model works, where it fails and what to improve.

From datasets to deployed software

These projects illustrate the proposed year-by-year progression. Ask admissions for the latest curriculum.

Year 1 Programs and data analysis

Write software and analyse data to solve practical problems.

Year 2 A recommendation model

Build a model such as a recommendation engine and test its results.

Year 3 Vision and language applications

Build applications using computer vision, language models and generative AI.

Year 4 An AI product for real users

Take a product to real users, then apply your skills in a supervised work semester.

Machine learning, data engineering and deployment

The proposed curriculum covers Python, data structures, algorithms, mathematics for machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, language models, generative AI, data engineering, model deployment and monitoring, and responsible AI.

Where it leads

Explore work as an AI or machine learning engineer, data scientist, applied AI engineer or MLOps engineer. The skills also support building an AI startup.

For those who want the detail

The course design moves from programming and data to training, evaluation and deployment. MLOps is the engineering work of putting models into use, monitoring how they perform and maintaining them over time.

See how AI is used in projects and assessments

Common questions

If AI writes code, why study computer science?

Computer science teaches you to design systems, evaluate the software a tool generates and improve the models that generate it.

Will I learn to deploy a model?

The proposed curriculum includes model deployment and monitoring alongside training and evaluation.
